summary: Flat kerb on a parked-up street, but homes sit 11 m away.
reasons: Houses 11 m from the kerb all along
Cars park on both sides of the road

best_section.where: South kerb under street trees, about halfway along the block

drivers.seclusion: Continuous houses 11 m back on this side and more across the road; neighbours would see a van.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with cars parked along both kerbs; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Residential street leading to the arterial; moderate local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked along both sides, so a van would not stand out; school-day 4P limits are signed.

flags: Homes 11 m away on the section's side
School days 9 AM-5 PM 4P parallel signs at both ends
Falls to about 10% grade towards the west end
Arterial noise at the west end
sun_shade: Street trees shade the south kerb at about 45-55 m; otherwise open, with afternoon sun from the west.
